name: Nazarbayev University Abay Kunanbayev Scholarship
eligibility_text:
Eligibility Criteria
Nationality Requirements
The Abay Kunanbayev Scholarship is exclusively for international applicants — citizens of countries other than Kazakhstan. Citizens of Kazakhstan, including those holding dual citizenship where one is Kazakhstani, are not eligible for this scholarship and would be considered under domestic funding mechanisms instead.

Admission Requirements
You must be recommended for admission by the Admissions Committee of the relevant NU programme. Each programme at NU has its own academic entry thresholds, including entrance assessments (academic aptitude and subject tests) and English language proficiency requirements. Satisfying those admission criteria is the primary gateway to the scholarship; once admitted, scholarship consideration is automatic.

English Proficiency
NU teaches entirely in English, and all programmes require demonstrated English language proficiency. Undergraduate applicants typically need to demonstrate language ability through NU's own English assessment or external tests. Master's and PhD applicants must meet programme-specific English requirements. Contact the NU admissions office at admissions.nu.edu.kz for current thresholds for your target programme.

No Separate Application
The scholarship does not require a separate form, essay, or interview. Qualification is determined as part of the standard admissions review. All international applicants who are recommended for admission are considered for the Abay Kunanbayev Scholarship by default.

What the Scholarship Covers
100% of tuition fees for the full normal duration of your bachelor's, master's, or PhD programme at NU
A monthly stipend, the amount of which is set by the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan and may be adjusted over time (contact NU's Bursar's Office for the current figure)
Basic medical insurance for the duration of the programme
Note: accommodation, meals, and personal expenses are not covered by the scholarship; NU has on-campus dormitories and off-campus housing options that students arrange and fund separately
